verdict.rationale: The evidence describes ykman as covering applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots and device info, but nothing documents listing or deleting resident FIDO2 passkeys, or reporting how many credential slots remain. python-fido2 and the SDKs are developer building blocks, and passkey marketing is adjacent, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power user, I can list and delete the passkeys stored on my key and know its credential capacity before it fills up
